versions.subject: Merge PR #5528 from @MATTANDERS0N - add rules for defense evasion
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_reg_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\Control\WMI\Autologger\DefenderApiLogger\Start'
        - '\Control\WMI\Autologger\DefenderAuditLogger\Start'
selection_reg_add:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'add'
        - '0'
filter_main_enable:
    CommandLine|contains: '0x00000001'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\reg.exe" OR OriginalFileName="reg.exe" CommandLine IN ("*\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderApiLogger\\Start*", "*\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderAuditLogger\\Start*") CommandLine="*add*" CommandLine="*0*" NOT CommandLine="*0x00000001*"
